source: NIRF data, industry reports, placement data from institute websites 2026

CSE.what_you_study: Programming, algorithms, data structures, OS, DBMS, computer networks, AI/ML, software engineering, theory of computation
CSE.higher_studies: MS (abroad), MTech, MBA, PhD - all very common
CSE.demand_trend: Rising sharply. Highest cutoffs across all institutes.
CSE.note: CSE cutoffs have risen every year 2018-2026. Even CSE at new IITs is highly competitive.

IT.what_you_study: Similar to CSE. More focus on software systems, web technologies, databases, networking
IT.vs_CSE: IT is very similar to CSE in most institutes. Minor curriculum difference. Placement outcomes nearly identical at good institutes.

ECE.what_you_study: Analog/digital electronics, VLSI, signal processing, communication systems, embedded systems, microprocessors
career_paths: Software (many ECE grads go into software)
Graduate studies in ECE or CS
ECE.higher_studies: Very popular for MS/MTech in ECE, VLSI, Signal Processing. Also common to switch to CS for MS.
ECE.demand_trend: Stable. VLSI sector growing rapidly in India post-semiconductor push.
ECE.note: ECE from top institutes often leads to VLSI/chip design roles at Intel, Qualcomm worth 20-40 LPA fresh. Software jobs also very accessible.

EEE.what_you_study: Power systems, electric machines, control systems, power electronics, digital systems
EEE.higher_studies: GATE for M.Tech / PSU. MS abroad in EE or CS. MBA.
EEE.demand_trend: Stable. EV revolution creating new demand. PSU sector always stable.
EEE.note: At IITs, EE is considered very prestigious and flexible. Many IIT EE grads go into software, finance, or VLSI.

Mechanical.what_you_study: Thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, manufacturing, machine design, CAD/CAM, robotics
career_paths: PSUs (NTPC, BHEL, Oil sector) via GATE
Mechanical.higher_studies: GATE for PSU/MTech. MBA very popular. MS in ME or related abroad.
Mechanical.demand_trend: Stable but slower than CS/ECE. Manufacturing and core sector hiring reliable.
Mechanical.note: Mechanical from top IITs still has strong placements. NITs also have solid placement for Mech but packages lower than CS.

Civil.what_you_study: Structural engineering, transportation, geotechnical, water resources, environmental engineering, surveying
Civil.demand_trend: Stable. Government infrastructure push creating demand. But private sector packages lower than CS.
Civil.higher_studies: GATE for PSU is most common path. MTech in Structural/Geotech. MS abroad.
Civil.note: Civil engineering offers strong government sector career path. Packages are lower than CS/ECE but job security in government roles is very high.

Chemical.what_you_study: Process engineering, thermodynamics, mass transfer, heat transfer, reaction engineering, petrochemicals
career_paths: MS abroad in ChemE or related

Aerospace.what_you_study: Aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, flight mechanics, avionics
Aerospace.availability: Only at few IITs (IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Kanpur)
Aerospace.higher_studies: MS/PhD abroad very common for this branch. US universities have strong aerospace programs.
Aerospace.note: Pure aerospace jobs in India mostly in government (ISRO, DRDO, HAL). Private aviation sector growing but limited. Many grads go into software or pursue MS abroad.

Metallurgy.what_you_study: Properties of metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites. Processing, characterization.
Metallurgy.demand_trend: Niche. Core metallurgy jobs exist but fewer than CS/ECE.
Metallurgy.note: Often called 'unpopular' branch but IIT Bombay Metallurgy still places students well. Many go for higher studies or switch careers.

Mining.what_you_study: Mining methods, rock mechanics, mine safety, mineral processing, mine management
Mining.availability: IIT Kharagpur, IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, NIT Rourkela, NIT Srinagar
Mining.note: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad is the premier institute for mining. Government mining PSUs are primary employers.

Naval_Architecture.what_you_study: Ship design, marine structures, ocean engineering, hydrodynamics
Naval_Architecture.note: Very niche. Good for those interested in maritime sector.

Engineering_Physics.what_you_study: Quantum mechanics, solid state physics, optics, electromagnetic theory, advanced mathematics. Rigorous theoretical foundation.
career_paths: MS/PhD abroad in Physics or related
Engineering_Physics.availability: IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, IIT Kanpur, IIT Roorkee
Engineering_Physics.note: Very research-oriented degree. Best for students targeting PhD/research. Not the best choice if you want software job without further study.

Mathematics_and_Computing.what_you_study: Pure mathematics + computer science. Strong theoretical CS, algorithms, statistics, probability, cryptography.
Mathematics_and_Computing.availability: IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, IIT Kharagpur, IIT Guwahati, IIT Roorkee
Mathematics_and_Computing.note: Highly sought after at IITs. Cutoffs close to or even better than CSE at some IITs. Excellent for quant finance and top software roles.
Mathematics_and_Computing.placement_outcome: Similar to or better than CSE at same IIT

Statistics_and_Data_Science.what_you_study: Statistics, probability, machine learning, data analysis, applied mathematics
Statistics_and_Data_Science.availability: IIT Bombay (B.Stat recently), IIT Kanpur, IIIT Hyderabad, some NITs

Biotech_Biomed.what_you_study: Molecular biology, genetics, bioprocessing, medical devices, bioinformatics
career_paths: MS/PhD abroad in Life Sciences or Biomedical
Biotech_Biomed.note: Campus placement in pure biotech is limited. Most students either go for higher studies or switch to software. Strong research career path.

Architecture.requires: JEE Main Paper 2A and AAT (for IIT BArch)
Architecture.what_you_study: Architectural design, building materials, urban planning, history of architecture, structures
Architecture.note: Very different from engineering branches. Design-oriented. Portfolio matters in career.

branch_selection_advice.if_rank_is_very_good: Top IIT with any branch often better than lesser NIT with CSE. IIT brand opens more doors.
branch_selection_advice.if_rank_is_moderate: Consider CSE/IT at top NIT vs other branch at old IIT. CSE at NIT Trichy vs Mechanical at IIT Patna - difficult call depending on career goals.
branch_selection_advice.for_software_career_any_branch: Many core branch graduates (Mech, Civil, ECE) successfully enter software via competitive programming, internships, and switching. The branch is not a hard barrier.
branch_selection_advice.branch_change_at_IITs: Possible after first year based on CGPA. Competitive. Usually top 5-10% of batch can change.
branch_selection_advice.branch_change_at_NITs: Available at some NITs but less common than IITs. Institute-specific rules.

dual_degree_vs_btech.dual_degree: B.Tech + M.Tech in 5 years at IITs. Must complete M.Tech research/project.
dual_degree_vs_btech.pros: Integrated PG degree. Research exposure. May have slightly better research-oriented placements.
dual_degree_vs_btech.cons: One extra year. If you decide to switch after 3rd year, difficult. Thesis requirement.
dual_degree_vs_btech.recommendation: Take dual degree only if you are interested in research or specific technical depth in that field.
